scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm build:shared && pnpm db:migrate:local
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @homehub/web build && pnpm --filter @homehub/api build
scripts.release:check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run db:check && pnpm privacy:check
scripts.release:migrate: pnpm --filter @homehub/api run db:pending:remote && pnpm --filter @homehub/api run db:bookmark:remote && pnpm --filter @homehub/api run db:migrate:remote
scripts.release:deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @homehub/api run worker:deploy
scripts.deploy: pnpm run release:check && pnpm run release:migrate && pnpm run release:deploy
